answer: I’d like the world to freeze solid indefinitely; imagine oceans stuck in glittering ice, forests preserved in perfect stillness, and society halted in whatever way it was before you. Meltage-powered utilities will halt, plastic waste will solidify and never disperse, and traffic jams will rez to the first year 2024. As long as every mature mosquit of every unpredictable genus is found somewhere existing just once, society can wait indefinitely.
